scope: Native Filesystem fallocate and sync vertical slice
required_user_semantics: fallocate mode 0 reserves capacity, extends EOF and reads unwritten bytes as zero
FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE reserves capacity without changing EOF
a write inside a local reservation consumes reserved capacity and is immediately visible from another Node
FALLOC_FL_PUNCH_HOLE with KEEP_SIZE preserves EOF and reads the punched range as zero
flush, fdatasync, fsync and directory fsync complete through SharedFileOperations
O_SYNC and O_DSYNC writes are visible from another Node when write returns
reservation admission failure returns ENOSPC without changing file size or leaking reserved bytes
Meta restart preserves reservation identity without reserving capacity twice
a restarted reservation owner fences its old reservation so another live Node can write the range
required_observability: typed FUSE callback counters for fallocate, flush, fsync and fsyncdir
Arena reserved bytes and reservation gauges
filesystem operation counters for fallocate, flush and sync
non_goals: durability stronger than the configured local-memory payload boundary
